items.title: Stage Timer
items.problem: Speakers and organizers needed a distraction-free fullscreen countdown that works on any phone or tablet.
items.work: End-to-end product engineering: UX, Android/Kotlin architecture, Play Store release. Free app, no ads.
items.result: Live product used at events and talks. Proof of shipping from idea to store.

items.title: Smart Baby Sleep LED
items.problem: Needed a smart night light controllable from mobile, with firmware and a companion app.
items.work: From Arduino firmware to BLE to the Android app: full stack from idea → prototype → documented product.
items.result: Working system and a public case study of the 0→1 path.

items.title: WebNFC VCard
items.problem: At meetups and conferences, contact exchange was slow: paper cards, scattered QR codes, no standard.
items.work: Web tool to write and share vCards via the Web NFC API — from prototype to a field-ready repo.
items.result: Working demo for contact exchange in event contexts.
